name: Select
propertyCopy: Size, corner radius, label and placeholder are properties of the same component, not separate fields - change them below to check this field's style and states in the Live Preview.
guide: Component Guide Human View Machine View Overview Select is a trigger field that opens a panel of predefined options, letting the user pick exactly one value from a known, fixed set - visually similar to Input but read-only and paired with a chevron, distinct from Dropdown (which triggers actions, not a form value) and Cascader (multi-level drill-down). When to Use A value from a known, fixed set - country, state/province, category. Sort order or similar single-choice configuration - Newest first, Price low to high. A language or locale picker - any small-to-medium closed option list. When Not to Use Free-form text with no fixed set of valid values - use Input. Hierarchical or nested data - use Cascader (linked columns) or Tree Select (an expandable tree). Selecting more than one value at a time - use a multi-select variant, Checkbox group, or Transfer. A very large option list better filtered by typing - use Autocomplete instead of scrolling a long panel. Best Practices Order options logically - alphabetical, by frequency of use, or with a sensible default first. Show an explicit placeholder like "Select an option" rather than silently pre-selecting an arbitrary value. Truncate long option labels gracefully in the closed trigger rather than letting them overflow the field. Do and Don't Do CountrySelect a country An explicit placeholder makes it obvious nothing has been chosen yet, so an untouched field cannot be mistaken for a decision. Don't CountryAfghanistan Pre-selecting the alphabetically-first option silently submits an answer nobody gave. Accessibility The trigger uses role="combobox" with aria-haspopup/aria-expanded, and the Open state shows a real role="listbox" panel with role="option" items and aria-selected on the current value - the roles a screen reader needs to announce this as a real picker, not a styled div. Keyboard focus stays on the trigger when closed and moves into the option list when open. A visible label is associated with the control, and the currently selected value is announced.
